description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzDao class, responsible for data access related to 'buzz' or social feed features in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, update, and delete various buzz-related entities such as posts, shares, comments, likes, photos, and links, as well as methods for counting and filtering these entities.

classes.name: BuzzDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing 'buzz' or social feed entities such as posts, comments, shares, likes, photos, and links within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzFeedPost objects based on filtering parameters, including posts, shares, likes, and links.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of BuzzFeedPosts matching the given filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Gets an array of photo IDs associated with a specific post.

methods.name: saveBuzzPost
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPost entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzShare entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLink entity (video link) to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzPhoto
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPhoto entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzComment entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Removes a BuzzComment entity from the database.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzPhoto by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzShareById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzComment by its ID, optionally filtering by share ID.

methods.name: getBuzzComments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzComments based on search filters.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of BuzzComments matching specified filters.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for BuzzComments based on search filters.

methods.name: isEmployeeLikedOnComment
methods.description: Checks whether an employee has liked a specific comment.

methods.name: getBuzzPostById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzPost entity by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzPostTypeByPostId
methods.description: Determines the type of a post (photo, video, text) based on its associated data.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPostPhotos
methods.description: Deletes specified photos from a post.

methods.name: getBuzzLinkByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLink associated with a specific post.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPost
methods.description: Deletes a BuzzPost by its ID.

methods.name: deleteBuzzShare
methods.description: Deletes a BuzzShare by its ID.

methods.name: adjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the counts of likes and comments on shares.

methods.name: adjustLikeCountOnComments
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the count of likes on comments.

methods.name: getBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare linked to a specific post ID.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesList
methods.description: Fetches a list of BuzzShares related to a post based on filters.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesCount
methods.description: Returns count of BuzzShares related to a post based on filters.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query for BuzzShares related to a specific post, with filtering options.
